Sergio Mendes & Brasil '66 – Look Around

Artist: Sergio Mendes & Brasil '66

Title: Look Around

Label: A&M Records

Catalog Number: SP-4137

Format: Vinyl LP, Stereo

A classic late-1960s album blending Brazilian bossa nova, jazz, and sophisticated pop arrangements. Features the group's signature style with lush vocals and Sergio Mendes' elegant piano work.

Includes

  • The Look of Love
  • With A Little Help From My Friends
  • Like A Lover
  • Look Around
  • So Many Stars
  • Roda
  • Batucada (The Beat)

A wonderful addition for collectors of Brazilian jazz, easy listening, and classic A&M Records releases.
